ai.seo_question: What are the three categories of people on the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as categorizing humanity into the 'Companions of the Right' (Ahl al-Yamin), the 'Companions of the Left' (Ahl al-Shimal), and a third group, sometimes identified as the 'Preceders' (Al-Sabiqun) or those in a state of uncertainty, reflecting the tripartite division of souls. This classification underscores the principle of divine justice, where individual deeds determine one's eternal station, a concept central to Shia eschatology. The verse thus serves not merely as a prediction but as a moral imperative for self-reflection and spiritual preparation.
